kv260.command:
ssh -o ConnectTimeout=5 -o BatchMode=yes kria 'python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import hashlib, json
payload = '"'"'{"edges": [[0, 1, 1], [1, 2, -1], [2, 3, 1], [3, 4, -1], [4, 5, 1], [6, 7, 1]], "expected_energy": 6, "experiment_id": "exp5255-hardware-continuity-pkit-boundary-v480", "spins": [1, -1, -1, 1, 1, -1, 1, -1], "workload": "exp5255_inline_hash_ising_smoke"}'"'"'
data = json.loads(payload)
spins = [int(value) for value in data['"'"'spins'"'"']]
energy = 0
for row, col, coupling in data['"'"'edges'"'"']:
    energy -= int(coupling) * spins[int(row)] * spins[int(col)]
out = {
    '"'"'board'"'"': '"'"'kv260'"'"',
    '"'"'workload_sha256'"'"': '"'"'01ed5fb420ba795a5e82fd81969ef80ef4bdd6c158dde4fc79d58d59876ff835'"'"',
    '"'"'binary_or_bitstream_sha256'"'"': '"'"'25fd63b0185d503c4479f0d86095fa802c95494940f6e286e25611d82729ee5e'"'"',
    '"'"'inference_substrate'"'"': '"'"'hardware_probe_no_speedup_claim'"'"',
    '"'"'energy'"'"': energy,
    '"'"'correctness'"'"': {'"'"'energy_matches_expected'"'"': energy == data['"'"'expected_energy'"'"']},
}
encoded = json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True, separators=('"'"','"'"', '"'"':'"'"')).encode()
out['"'"'output_sha256'"'"'] = hashlib.sha256(encoded).hexdigest()
print(json.dumps(out, sort_keys=True))
PY'
